data.text: I'll start by creating the report module. First, let me set up a todo list and write the test (TDD), then implement.

Task 5 is complete.

## Summary

Implemented the delivery report route for the read-only dashboard, strictly within scope (`packages/ui/src/report/`, `packages/ui/src/app.tsx`, `tests/ui-report.test.tsx`).

**New report module** (all files ≤ 250 lines):
- `scales.ts` — finite linear/band scale and path helpers that tolerate singleton domains, all-zero data, empty input, and non-finite values.
- `format.ts` — cost/percent/duration/date formatting; `costWithCoverage` always places `n of m … reported` beside a value; null model renders as `model unavailable`.
- `landed.ts` — `landedChanges` (archived + valid landed time, sorted timestamp then key), `planningBoundaryIndex`, `aggregateTokens`, `passWindows` (windows of ≤5), `durationHistogram`, `capabilityWriteSeries`.
- `Figure.tsx` + five chart components — exactly five semantic `<figure>`/`<svg>` charts with deterministic marks, `<title>`/`<desc>`, and accessible `DataTable` value alternatives.
- `RepositoryTotals.tsx`, `ScopePanel.tsx` — unchanged `MetricsReport` totals/coverage, separate legacy vs resolver-2 scope-file evidence with boundary, combined acceptance-line table, and the five scope-regression counters as a compact labelled table.

`app.tsx` now renders `<ReportView>` in place of only the report placeholder; graph/change placeholders remain for tasks 6–7.

**Tests**: `tests/ui-report.test.tsx` — 17 tests covering all seven acceptance lines, including late planning boundary, partial coverage, recorded zero, both resolver generations, empty/malformed history, input immutability, no network access, and line budget.

**Verification**: `pnpm verify` exits 0 — CLI typecheck, UI typecheck, production UI build, 1220 Node tests, 31 UI `.tsx` tests, Biome clean over 267 files.

Result documented at `openspec/changes/044-read-only-dashboard/.run/results/5.md`, including the one judgment call (token/duration charts aggregate all non-rejected graph nodes while the three landed timelines use only archived nodes).
